title: UFO intercept - Major Milton Torres speaking at the 2009 X Conference
description:
X-Conference 2009  - Milton Torres. In May 1957, U.S. pilot Milton Torres scrambled his F-86 D Sabre jet in calm weather from the Royal Air Force base at Manston, Kent to intercept an unknown object that appeared on radar.
